style: Original iPhone-inspired artwork; not Apple assets

prompts.faces:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production emoji sprite-sheet atlas for a photobooth web app.
Primary request: Create a consistent ORIGINAL emoji collection inspired by the polished shaded emoji look of an iPhone keyboard. Not copies of Apple's artwork. Smooth warm yellow face spheres, readable expressive features, precise shapes, restrained 3D shading and soft highlights, clean crisp silhouettes. Friendly high quality mobile emoji, not stickers with borders.
Composition: EXACTLY 5 columns and 4 rows, 20 equal square cells, landscape aspect ratio 5:4, ideally 1600 by 1280 pixels. Each emoji centered at its cell midpoint, completely isolated with at least 18% clear transparent padding inside each cell. The sheet has no outer margin beyond the equal cells. Entire background true transparent alpha, including the gutters. No grid lines, no text, no labels, no numbers, no white outlines, no drop shadows outside silhouettes, no logos.
The precise row-major cell contents left to right:
Row 1: Grinning face; Grinning face with big eyes; Grinning face with smiling eyes; Beaming grin with teeth; Laughing squinting face.
Row 2: Smiling face with sweat; Face with tears of joy; Slight smile; Upside-down smile; Winking face.
Row 3: Smiling face with rosy cheeks; Heart eyes; Smiling face with three hearts; Blowing a kiss; Face with sunglasses.
Row 4: Face holding back tears; Loudly crying face; Sleeping face; Thinking face; Star eyes.
Include each cell's requested emoji once, no extras, keep features recognizable at 36px. This single atlas will be used directly by a CSS/Canvas sprite renderer. Alignment and exact order are essential.
